node.statement: Let J_Q=I_{n+1} tensor Q and J_P=I_{n+1} tensor P. By node 1.2, R_Y lies in S_{J_Q,J_P} and C_X lies in S_{J_P,J_Q}. Therefore def-compressed-corner, applied to the triple (J_Q,J_P,J_Q), gives R_Y dot C_X=Co_{J_Q,J_Q}(R_Y C_X). Since the same definition prescribes the abbreviation Co_R when the two indices agree, Co_{J_Q,J_Q}=Co_{J_Q}; hence R_Y dot C_X=Co_{I_{n+1} tensor Q}(R_Y C_X). This uses node 1.2 for the corner-membership premises; node 1.3.1 is used separately to identify R_Y C_X.
